acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
An elections administrator in Texas, Heider Garcia, uses a radical approach to try to win over election skeptics: tactical patience. Can it work? Natalia Contreras and Zoe Chace look into it.
You can find more of Natalia’s work – including Natalia’s print story about this – at Votebeat.org.
acts.credits: By Natalia Contreras and Zoe Chace, Shelby Tauber for The Texas Tribune
acts.title: Flies, Meet Honey
